evals.name: unmapped_slash_command_lookup
evals.prompt: User enters command //seo-optimizer to audit their article metadata.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes skill shortcut, invokes kungfu find seo-optimizer or kungfu load seo-optimizer, and incorporates the skill instructions.
assertions: Invokes kungfu find or kungfu load for 'seo-optimizer'
Identifies matching skill in catalog results
Uses kungfu load to retrieve skill instructions without cluttering the workspace
Does not error or report unknown command failure without checking catalog

evals.name: multi_skill_jit_loading_with_pagination
evals.prompt: Load both godoctor and ebitengineer skills into the current session context and read all pages.
evals.expected_output: Agent executes kungfu load individually for each skill (kungfu load godoctor, then kungfu load ebitengineer, advancing with -p 2 when paginated) and incorporates verbatim instructions.
assertions: Runs kungfu load individually for godoctor and ebitengineer
Uses -p <N> when a skill response indicates additional pages
Does not create files on disk (.agents/skills/ is untouched)
Acknowledges capabilities of both loaded skills

evals.name: workspace_persistence_learning
evals.prompt: Install the skill-optimizer skill into our project workspace.
evals.expected_output: Agent executes kungfu learn skill-optimizer, writing to .agents/skills/skill-optimizer/SKILL.md.
assertions: Runs kungfu learn skill-optimizer without -g flag
Reports success to user with skill summary
Preserves existing files unless --force is specified

evals.name: catalog_scoped_subpath_and_script_execution
evals.prompt: Find testing skills in the go-skills catalog, load the architecture reference from godoctor, and run its smart_build script.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs kungfu find testing@go-skills, kungfu load godoctor/references/architecture.md, and kungfu run godoctor smart_build.
assertions: Uses @go-skills catalog qualifier in kungfu find
Loads bundled reference via kungfu load godoctor/references/architecture.md
Executes companion script via kungfu run godoctor smart_build without searching disk
